items: UPS posts 2027 preview rate tables. The tables cover Daily Package Rates, Alaska and Hawaii Daily Package Rates, and Hundredweight Service Package Rates, effective December 21, 2026. UPS also says rates for certain Value-Added services and Other Charges will increase, without quantifying the change.

UPS posts 2027 Next Day Air daily rates. In zone 102, a Next Day Air Early letter is $69.73 against $39.73 for Next Day Air, and a 1 lb package is $77.99 against $47.99. The rates are effective December 21, 2026.

Amazon: FBA fuel surcharge doesn't cover costs. Amazon said its existing Fulfillment by Amazon fuel surcharge does not fully offset higher fuel and linehaul costs. Third-quarter shipping costs rose 11% against 12% growth in units shipped, and CEO Andy Jassy said transportation cost pressure is expected to continue into the fourth quarter.
